title: Loyalty Credit for Long-Insured HomeFlood Addresses
content:
**Rule.** A HomeFlood Private Residential Flood Policies renewal term premium carries a loyalty credit that follows how long Tidemark has insured the address. The length is counted in whole calendar months to the booking date, from one of two starting points:
- the original effective date of the customer's NFIP record for the address — the Tidemark NFIP Dwelling Form policy, of the NFIP Dwelling Form Flood Policies (Write Your Own), that this HomeFlood policy replaced, the one whose policy number is the policy's replaced NFIP policy number;
- without such a record, this HomeFlood policy's effective date.

| Months Tidemark has insured the address | Loyalty credit |
|---|---|
| 180 or more | 5 percent |
| at least 60 but fewer than 180 | 2 percent |
| fewer than 60 | none |

**Form of the credit.** The credit is a percent of the premium the renewal term premium starts from, and it is subtracted from that premium.

**The booking date.** The booking date is the day the renewal is booked and recorded, and every window and length of time counted to the booking date ends on that day. A count of whole calendar months runs from the earlier date to the later one; the last month is not counted when the later date's day of the month falls before the earlier date's day of the month.

**Records read.** The NFIP record's original effective date is read from the NFIP Dwelling Form policy record.

## Hypothetical cases

| Starting point | Booking date | Whole months | Credit |
|---|---|---|---|
| NFIP record's original effective date 10 May, 16 years before | 10 May | 192 | 5 percent |
| HomeFlood effective date 12 March, 5 years before | 11 March | 59 | none |
| HomeFlood effective date 12 March, 5 years before | 12 March | 60 | 2 percent |
